notes: Checked against the book's 4th and 3rd edition pages and colophons. The current 4th edition is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, so the claim that the book is CC BY-SA 4.0 holds only for the 3rd edition, which is still online. An app may show passages from the 3rd edition with credit, and only links to the 4th. discrete.openmathbooks.org/ itself redirects to a plain-http address, so link to the https edition pages directly. The bank's agents don't read it and nothing from it goes into the bank.
